versions.changelog:
v1.2.0: Environment variables (SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY, SOLANA_RPC_URL) are now optional — agents can check jackpot, stats, and round info without a wallet.
Added SECURITY.md explaining private key usage. Added agent trigger instructions so models automatically use the FORTUNA API instead of web search.

Declared required environment variables (SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY, SOLANA_RPC_URL) in metadata. Added security section with recommendations for safe key

- Initial release of the fortuna skill.
- Enables participation in the FORTUNA lottery on Solana: check jackpot, round status, and buy tickets.
- Provides instructions for checking round details and purchasing tickets with SOL.
- Includes tips for maximizing chances and playing responsibly.
- Lists API endpoints for round status, ticket verification, history, and stats.
